Legal.p1Text: This Privacy Policy sets out the rules for processing and protecting personal data provided by users in connection with the use of the WeddingDrop platform.
Legal.p2Text: The controller of personal data contained in the service is [COMPANY NAME OR FULL NAME], with its registered office at [ADDRESS].
Legal.p3Title: 3. Collected Data and Purpose of Processing
Legal.p3Text: We process data voluntarily submitted by users (e.g., photos, videos) solely for the purpose of sharing them within a specific, private wedding gallery.
Legal.p4Text: Uploaded multimedia materials are visible to other individuals holding a link or QR code to the respective wedding gallery. We do not share data with third parties for marketing purposes.
Legal.p5Text: Every user has the right to access their data, correct it, and request its deletion. To exercise these rights, please contact us at: [EMAIL ADDRESS].
Legal.t1Text: These regulations define the rules for providing and using the services of the WeddingDrop platform, used for sharing and downloading multimedia from wedding celebrations.
Legal.t2Text: Using the service is free for wedding guests. The user agrees not to upload content that is illegal, offensive, or violates the rights of third parties.
Legal.t3Text: By uploading materials, the user retains full copyrights to them while granting permission for their display and download by others with access to the gallery.
Legal.t4Text: The administrator is not liable for content (including photos and videos) posted by platform users. Any disputed materials may be removed by the gallery administrator.
Legal.t5Text: The administrator reserves the right to make changes to these regulations. Changes take effect on the date of their publication on the website.

LandingPage.heroTitle: All photos from your wedding in one place
LandingPage.heroSubtitle: Guests scan a QR code from the table and upload photos straight from their phones. No app to install, no login required, and no limits.
LandingPage.feature1Desc: Automatic generator of print-ready high-resolution wedding table cards.
LandingPage.feature2Desc: TUS protocol ensures that a broken Wi-Fi/LTE connection at the venue resumes without data loss.
LandingPage.feature3Desc: The couple downloads all photos with one click without waiting for compression and without clogging RAM.
LandingPage.footerText: WeddingDrop • Self-Hosted Wedding Gallery Platform • Optimized for Intel N100
